## Checklist — adding new link(s) 新增链接必读

<!-- Only for adding new link(s); skip for other changes. 仅收录新链接时需要完成，其他改动可跳过。 -->

- [ ] Not already listed — searched `README.md`, `websites.md` and `stackoverflow-women.md`. 链接未被收录过（已在三个列表文件中搜索）。
- [ ] Entry format: `- [Name](URL) - one-line description`, consistent with sibling entries. 条目格式为 `- [名称](URL) - 一句话描述`，与所在分类既有条目一致，一句话描述必填。
- [ ] Placed in the most fitting existing section. 已放入最贴合的既有分类。
- [ ] New section (if any): top TOC of `README.md` updated, and >= 3 entries added to it in this PR. 新增分类：已同步更新 README.md 顶部 TOC，且本 PR 向其收录至少 3 条。
- [ ] No more than 20 new links per PR — links beyond 20 are not covered by the security scan. 单 PR 新增链接不超过 20 个（超出部分不会被安全扫描覆盖）。
- [ ] No affiliate / promotional links; content is legal and safe. 无联盟或推广性质链接，内容合法合规。
